name: preview-route-runtime
goal: Managed preview keeps server and client route indexes aligned after normal SvelteKit sync.

evidence: Pages must hydrate Pages after normal SvelteKit sync while the managed preview remains running. Bun and Node manifest inventories produce different node order.
Existing preview lifecycle fixtures use plain Vite HTML, so they never compared real SvelteKit server node IDs against client modules after external sync. Extended that same lifecycle test.
Committed test 14e16604 fails with real hydration mismatch: red record 77e73281. The valid fixture adds routes in authoring order, then runs the normal sync command.
Fix 3ccd1e8b launches managed Vite with Node, matching normal SvelteKit sync without changing the regression corpus.
Formal green 57c0f081 at 3ccd1e8b passes the unchanged red command and tests from 14e16604; all eight preview lifecycle checks also pass.
